title: Koruyucu testler iş dalında, liste ve koşucu: team/guards.json + listeyi bir dalın kendi ağacında ajansız koşan betik; lead kapıdan önce elle koşar
roadmap_row: Repairs and improves itself (How it is built from here: the team cycle)
goal: Proposal team/proposals/2026-10-02-koruyucu-testler-is-dalinda.md, the list and the runner: usable by hand from the day it merges, wired into nothing. scripts/team/cycle.ps1, scripts/lib/TeamRun.ps1, scripts/lib/TeamQueue.ps1, scripts/tests/team-cycle.tests.ps1, scripts/tests/lib/fake-claude.ps1, scripts/team/integrate.ps1, scripts/quality-gate.ps1, .claude/agents/inspector.md and .claude/agents/worker.md are other cards' areas: this card does NOT touch them and puts no step into the cycle - the step is a later card that calls this runner. No new scripts/tests/*.tests.ps1 is written (it would need a line in scripts/quality-gate.ps1, which is not this card's): the tests are a pytest file that drives Windows PowerShell 5.1, the shape of _powershell / _collect in services/api/tests/unit/test_stt_utterance_corpus.py, so the gate's unit step runs them with no wiring. CONTRACT (identical in cards branch-guards-runner and branch-guards-rules): team/guards.json is {version: 1, guards: [{id (a-z, 0-9, '-'), kind: 'pytest' | 'powershell', path (repository-relative, forward slashes), label (the Turkish sentence the owner sees when it is red)}]}. A guard run's RESULT is one JSON object {at: UTC ISO-8601, sha: the 40-hex HEAD of the tree that was run, seconds: number, status: 'green' | 'red', rows: [{id, path, outcome: 'green' | 'red' | 'hung' | 'missing', seconds, label, detail}]}; one row per entry of the list, in the list's order; status is 'green' only when every row's outcome is 'green'; label is copied from the list; detail is at most 400 characters of the run's own failing lines (the failing test names), empty for a green row; 'hung' = stopped by the hang guard, 'missing' = the list names a file the tree does not have. BUILD: (1) team/guards.json with the proposal's six, all of which exist today: owner-error-language (services/api/tests/unit/test_owner_error_language.py, 'Türkçe hata cümlesi eksik'), ci-covers-every-suite (services/api/tests/unit/test_ci_covers_every_suite.py, 'yeni test dosyası kapıya bağlı değil'), postgres-coverage-ratchet (services/api/tests/unit/test_postgres_coverage_ratchet.py, 'tablo gerçek PostgreSQL üzerinde sınanmamış'), host-snapshot-schema (services/api/tests/unit/test_host_snapshot_schema.py, 'ev sahibi görüntüsü şemayla uyuşmuyor'), script-syntax (scripts/tests/script-syntax.tests.ps1, 'PowerShell 5.1 sözdizimi hatası'), installer-strictmode (scripts/tests/installer-strictmode.tests.ps1, 'katı kipte patlayan PowerShell'). (2) scripts/lib/TeamGuards.ps1 (Windows PowerShell 5.1, StrictMode-clean; it may dot-source scripts/lib/TeamQueue.ps1 for Read-TeamJson and Get-TeamTimestamp and does not edit it): Read-TeamGuardList -Path -> the entries, or a refusal with a Turkish reason for an unknown kind, a duplicate id, an absolute path, a drive letter, '..' or an empty label; Get-TeamGuardCommand -Guard -Worktree -Python -> the executable, the arguments and the working directory: for 'pytest' the given interpreter with -m pytest on the WORKTREE's file, cwd = <worktree>/services/api, an explicit --rootdir (a pytest child whose cwd and file sit on different drives hung 300 s collecting on this machine) and -p no:cacheprovider; for 'powershell' Windows PowerShell 5.1 -NoProfile -File on the WORKTREE's file - the same commands scripts/quality-gate.ps1 uses for these files (its 'API unit tests' and 'Script syntax' steps; read it, do not edit it); Invoke-TeamGuards -Worktree -List -Python -HangSeconds -> the RESULT. It runs the worktree's copy of every guard, never the main checkout's; guards run one after another; a guard that outlives HangSeconds (default a named constant, a hang guard and never a measure of success) has its WHOLE process tree stopped, its row is 'hung' and the remaining guards still run; a missing file is 'missing' and the rest still run. It never runs `uv sync` and never creates a virtualenv in the worktree: -Python defaults to the interpreter of the main checkout's API environment (find what `uv run` resolves to there and name it in the ADR; the editable install pins the main checkout for a loose script but pytest started in the worktree's services/api imports the worktree's tree - the scratch proof below is what shows it). The run leaves the worktree as it found it: `git status --porcelain` is identical before and after. (3) scripts/team/guards.ps1 -Worktree <path> [-List <path>, default the worktree's own team/guards.json] [-OutFile <path>] [-HangSeconds <n>] [-Python <path>]: prints 'koruyucular: yeşil' or, per non-green row, one Turkish line built from the outcome and the label ('koruyucu kırmızı: <label>', and its own wording for 'hung' and for 'missing'); writes the RESULT as UTF-8 without BOM to -OutFile when given; exit 0 = green, 1 = at least one non-green row, 2 = could not run at all (no list, a refused list, the path is not a git work tree, the interpreter is absent) - three exit codes, three different behaviours. It behaves the same started with `powershell -NoProfile -File` and typed by name in a session. It starts no agent and calls no network. (4) .claude/agents/lead.md: ONE paragraph, frontmatter byte-identical, nothing else reworded: before the full gate on the integration branch the lead runs `scripts/team/guards.ps1 -Worktree <the gate worktree>`; a non-green row is wired or sent back first and the 80-minute gate is not started on a red guard; a row whose fix is in a shared file is the lead's own wiring line. The paragraph promises nothing about the cycle doing this by itself. (5) MEASURE, the proposal's first duty: run the six on the real main checkout at rest and once while another pytest run is going; the report and the ADR carry seconds per guard and the total; if the total at rest is over 180 s, drop the slowest guard(s) from the list until it is under, and say which and why (the gate still runs them). One ADR in team/plans/branch-guards-runner-adr.md (the lead numbers it and writes docs/DECISIONS.md and the TEAM_PROTOCOL clause): the list and why these six, the two contracts, the interpreter choice, the four outcomes and three exit codes, the measured times, that a red guard on a task branch can be red by nature (a new suite is wired only at integration) and therefore stops nothing by itself, and that pytest-testmon was looked at and not taken.
acceptance: Red first: services/api/tests/unit/test_team_guards_runner.py fails before TeamGuards.ps1 and guards.ps1 exist (the report shows that run), then passes; skipped only where Windows PowerShell is absent. Every runner case builds its OWN scratch git repository under tmp_path with tiny fake guards (a PowerShell file that exits 0, one that exits 1 after printing a failing name, one that sleeps; a one-line pytest file that passes and one that fails) and passes sys.executable as -Python - no test runs the six real guards and no test changes the shared tree. One named test each: (1) the real team/guards.json: it parses with Read-TeamGuardList, every path exists in the repository, ids are unique, kind matches the file (.py under services/api/tests/unit for 'pytest', .tests.ps1 under scripts/tests for 'powershell'), every label is non-empty, and every 'powershell' guard's file name appears in the text of scripts/quality-gate.ps1 - a list entry the gate does not run is a failure; (2) a bad list - unknown kind, duplicate id, 'C:/x', '/x', '../x', empty label - is refused, one case each, and guards.ps1 exits 2; (3) all green -> exit 0, status 'green', one row per entry in the list's order, every CONTRACT key present with its type, sha = the scratch repository's HEAD (40 hex), the first printed line is 'koruyucular: yeşil'; (4) one red PowerShell guard and one red pytest guard -> exit 1, status 'red', those rows 'red' with the failing name in detail (at most 400 characters), the green rows still 'green', the printed lines carry the labels; (5) a list entry whose file the worktree lacks -> that row 'missing', the others ran, exit 1; (6) a sleeping guard with -HangSeconds 2 -> that row 'hung', the guard AFTER it still ran and is green, and the sleeper's process is gone (it wrote its pid to a file; the test waits for the process to end with a deadline of its own - the bound is a hang guard, the assertion is the outcome and the dead pid); (7) count the DISTINCT printed wordings for 'red', 'hung' and 'missing': three; and the three exit codes are reached by three different inputs; (8) the worktree's copy is what runs: the scratch repository's guard fails while a same-named file beside the list in another directory passes -> 'red'; (9) `git status --porcelain` of the scratch repository is byte-identical before and after a run that had a red and a green pytest guard (no .pytest_cache, nothing untracked); (10) the path is not a git work tree, the list is absent, -Python names no file -> exit 2 each, with a Turkish line saying which; (11) -OutFile is valid JSON, UTF-8 without BOM, Turkish letters of a label intact, and equal to the RESULT; (12) invoked with -File and invoked by dot-less name from a PowerShell session give the same exit code and the same RESULT rows; (13) .claude/agents/lead.md names scripts/team/guards.ps1, that file exists, and the frontmatter block of lead.md equals the base branch's byte for byte. Mutation RED with sha256 restore from a backup copy (never git checkout), three separate mutations, each turning a named case red and none of them a mutation that hangs: status computed as always 'green'; the runner pointed at the main checkout's copy of the guard instead of the worktree's; exit code 1 turned into 0. On the REAL repository, outside the unit suite and never in the shared tree: in a scratch worktree of the base (git worktree add under the temp directory), `scripts/team/guards.ps1` is green; with one Turkish sentence removed from the catalogue test_owner_error_language.py reads, it exits 1 with the row owner-error-language red and the test's name in detail; the scratch worktree is removed afterwards; the raw output of both runs is in the report. The measured seconds per guard (at rest, and beside another pytest run) are in the report. scripts/tests/script-syntax.tests.ps1 and scripts/tests/installer-strictmode.tests.ps1 pass with the two new scripts in the tree (raw counts); the full unit suite is green with raw counts or, if it cannot finish, the report says how far it ran. Only the six files of the area are changed.
evidence_expected: PROVEN_AUTOMATED: the red-first run, the new file's raw counts under PowerShell 5.1, three mutation REDs with restore hashes, 40-hex sha. PROVEN_PROXY: the two real-repository runs in the scratch worktree (green, then red on the removed sentence) with raw output, and the measured times - the inspector repeats the red one itself. Nothing is wired into the cycle by this card, so nothing here is READY_FOR_OWNER. PROVEN_REAL belongs to the later wiring card: a real cycle in which a task shows a 'koruyucu kırmızı' line and that integration's gate is green on its first run; the count of first-run-red gates over the next five integrations is the lead's to write.

title: Koruyucu testler iş dalında, kural katmanı: sonucu karta yazan, denetleyiciye gösteren, lead'in bağlama listesini çıkaran ve 'çözülmemiş satır varken kapı başlamaz' kararını veren saf kütüphane
roadmap_row: Repairs and improves itself (How it is built from here: the team cycle)
goal: Proposal team/proposals/2026-10-02-koruyucu-testler-is-dalinda.md, what happens to a guard run's result - as PURE functions in a NEW file scripts/lib/TeamGuardRules.ps1 (Windows PowerShell 5.1, StrictMode-clean; it dot-sources scripts/lib/TeamQueue.ps1 and reuses Get-TeamProperty, Set-TeamProperty, Get-TeamTimestamp without editing it; it starts no process, reads no file, writes no store). The runner is on main when this card starts (scripts/lib/TeamGuards.ps1, scripts/team/guards.ps1, team/guards.json - read them, do not edit them). scripts/team/cycle.ps1, scripts/lib/TeamRun.ps1, scripts/lib/TeamQueue.ps1, scripts/tests/team-cycle.tests.ps1, scripts/tests/lib/fake-claude.ps1, scripts/team/integrate.ps1, scripts/quality-gate.ps1, team/queue.schema.json, services/api/app/team, apps/web/app/core/office and the role files under .claude/agents are other cards' areas: NOT touched, nothing is wired - the cycle step, the schema field, the inspector's paragraph and the Ofis line are later cards that call these functions. No scripts/tests/*.tests.ps1 is written; the tests are a pytest file driving PowerShell 5.1 (the shape of _powershell / _collect in services/api/tests/unit/test_stt_utterance_corpus.py), ONE PowerShell process for the whole file: a driver written to tmp_path dot-sources the library, runs every case of a cases file and prints one JSON document the tests then read. CONTRACT (identical in cards branch-guards-runner and branch-guards-rules): team/guards.json is {version: 1, guards: [{id (a-z, 0-9, '-'), kind: 'pytest' | 'powershell', path (repository-relative, forward slashes), label (the Turkish sentence the owner sees when it is red)}]}. A guard run's RESULT is one JSON object {at: UTC ISO-8601, sha: the 40-hex HEAD of the tree that was run, seconds: number, status: 'green' | 'red', rows: [{id, path, outcome: 'green' | 'red' | 'hung' | 'missing', seconds, label, detail}]}; one row per entry of the list, in the list's order; status is 'green' only when every row's outcome is 'green'; label is copied from the list; detail is at most 400 characters of the run's own failing lines (the failing test names), empty for a green row; 'hung' = stopped by the hang guard, 'missing' = the list names a file the tree does not have. THE CARD FIELD this layer owns: task.guards = {at, sha, status, runs, open: [{id, label, outcome, detail, sha}], resolved: [{id, by: 'branch' | 'integration', sha, at}]}. Functions: (a) Set-TeamGuardResult -Task -Result -Now: a run on the task's own branch. open becomes exactly the non-green rows of this RESULT; a row that was open and is green now moves to resolved with by = 'branch'; runs is incremented; the same RESULT (same sha) given twice changes nothing the second time. It touches ONLY task.guards: state, returns, reason, area and depends_on are what they were - a red guard alone neither stops nor returns a task (it can be red by nature: a new suite is wired into the gate only at integration). (b) Get-TeamGuardInspectorNote -Task -> the text the cycle will put in front of the inspector: nothing for a task never guard-run; 'koruyucular: yeşil' with the short sha for a green one; for a red one a line per open row (id, label, outcome, detail) and the two-way rule in one sentence - a fix inside the card's area is an item of the RETURN, a fix outside it (a shared file, the gate's list) is named in the report and becomes the lead's wiring line; the verdict stays the inspector's. (c) Get-TeamGuardWiringList -Tasks -> the lead's bağlama listesi: one record {task, id, label, detail} for every open row of a task whose state is merged; a task in any other state contributes nothing. (d) Resolve-TeamGuardRows -Tasks -Result -Now: a run on the INTEGRATION branch. An open row of a merged task whose guard id is 'green' in this RESULT moves to resolved with by = 'integration' and the RESULT's sha; a row whose guard is not green there, or whose id the RESULT does not carry, stays open; running it twice with the same RESULT changes nothing the second time. (e) Test-TeamGuardsBlockGate -Tasks -> Blocked (bool) and Why (a Turkish sentence naming each task id with its labels): blocked when at least one merged task still has an open row; a task with no guards field does not block (cards from before the step) - write that choice in the ADR with 'sahip incelemesi bekliyor'. (f) Get-TeamGuardOfficeText -Task -> the Ofis sentence: '' for never run, 'koruyucular: yeşil', or one sentence built from the open rows with a wording of its own per outcome ('koruyucu kırmızı: <label>', and distinct wordings for 'hung' and 'missing'), several rows joined with '; '. One ADR in team/plans/branch-guards-rules-adr.md (the lead numbers it and writes docs/DECISIONS.md): the card field, who resolves a row and how (a later green run of the same guard, on the branch or on the integration branch - never a hand edit), why red alone changes no state, why the inspector's verdict is not overridden, what blocks the gate, and that the field reaches the store and the queue schema only with the wiring card.
acceptance: Red first: services/api/tests/unit/test_team_guard_rules.py fails before TeamGuardRules.ps1 exists (the report shows that run), then passes; skipped only where Windows PowerShell is absent; one PowerShell process for the file. One named test each: (1) a green RESULT on a fresh task -> guards.status 'green', open empty, runs 1; (2) a RESULT with one 'red', one 'hung' and one 'missing' row -> three open rows with id, label, outcome, detail and sha, in the RESULT's order; the task's state, returns, reason, area and depends_on are equal to what they were (compared field by field); (3) the same RESULT twice -> the second call leaves guards equal to the first (runs still 1); a later green RESULT with a new sha -> open empty, the three rows in resolved with by 'branch' and the new sha, runs 2; (4) the inspector note: nothing for a never-run task; the green line; for the red task every open row's label and detail and the two-way sentence - and the text contains none of the words APPROVE / RETURN / REJECT as a line of its own, so Get-TeamVerdict of TeamQueue.ps1 run over 'note + a report ending in APPROVE' still reads APPROVE; (5) the wiring list: a merged task with two open rows gives two records; the same task in each of approved, assigned, in_progress, inspecting, returned and stopped gives none; (6) Resolve-TeamGuardRows: a guard green in the integration RESULT resolves the row with by 'integration' and that sha; a guard still red there stays open; a guard id absent from the RESULT stays open; a second call with the same RESULT changes nothing; an inspecting task's rows are not touched by an integration RESULT; (7) the gate: not blocked with no merged task, with merged tasks that are green, and with a merged task that has no guards field; blocked with one open row on a merged task, and Why names that task's id and label; unblocked after case 6 resolved it; (8) the Ofis text: count the DISTINCT outputs for never-run, green, red, hung and missing - five; two open rows are joined in one sentence; no output contains 'null' or an empty label; (9) the three real cases of the proposal as fixtures: b35c6ddb - owner-error-language red with the 'unexpected' class in detail -> the inspector note carries 'Türkçe hata cümlesi eksik'; 2c691585 - ci-covers-every-suite red naming team-feed.tests.ps1, the task approved and merged -> on the wiring list, the gate blocked, then an integration RESULT green for that guard -> resolved, not blocked; the bare .Count of TeamRun.ps1 - installer-strictmode red, then the worker's second run green -> open empty, resolved by 'branch'; (10) the two halves read each other: the REAL scripts/team/guards.ps1 is run on a scratch git repository under tmp_path with one failing fake guard, and the RESULT file it wrote - not a hand-built one - is fed to Set-TeamGuardResult and comes back as one open row with the runner's label and detail; and every label of the real team/guards.json passes through Get-TeamGuardOfficeText with its Turkish letters intact. Mutation RED with sha256 restore from a backup copy (never git checkout), three separate mutations, each turning a named case red: Test-TeamGuardsBlockGate ignoring open rows; Resolve-TeamGuardRows resolving a row whose guard is still red; the same-sha check of Set-TeamGuardResult removed. scripts/tests/script-syntax.tests.ps1 and scripts/tests/installer-strictmode.tests.ps1 pass with the new file in the tree, and services/api/tests/unit/test_team_guards_runner.py passes unchanged (raw counts); the full unit suite is green with raw counts or the report says how far it ran. Only the three files of the area are changed.
evidence_expected: PROVEN_AUTOMATED: the red-first run, the file's raw counts under PowerShell 5.1, the join test against the real runner, three mutation REDs with restore hashes, 40-hex sha. Nothing is wired into the cycle by this card, so nothing here is PROVEN_PROXY or READY_FOR_OWNER and the owner sees nothing new yet. PROVEN_REAL belongs to the later wiring card's first real cycles (a 'koruyucu kırmızı' line on a real card, the gate not started while it is open, that integration's gate green on its first run).
